notes.title: Hotfix for March 29
notes.notes:
Fixes

 All doors except main (front) door are closed and locked for the last task.
 All pickup objects will now drop exactly at the player's position if the object may be dropped behind a wall, something similar, or into the void.

(NOTE: A proper fix for the pickups will be coming in the future, and the fuses will be made to only appear once you get up to their task to avoid bringing them to the fuse boxes beforehand.)

notes.title: Update Notes for March 21
notes.notes:
Updates:

 Added subtle head-bob animation when entering and exiting the crouching state.

Fixes:

 Fixed an issue with player unable to place first fuse in fuse box properly, causing the fuse to shrink and be stuck in the player's hand from a distance.
 Fixed an issue with Nanite causing certain models to appear low-poly.
